shared_elements: large upright stone monument with rounded top
shallow low-relief carving on a rough stone surface
horizontal band dividing the field into registers
incised linear detailing suggestive of headdress or headgear
justification: Both are rounded-topped stone monuments carved in shallow, softly modelled relief with curvilinear scrolls, disc forms and a horizontal band separating an upper zone from a lower one, and both are photographed on museum plinths. The decisive difference is that A is a flat slab bearing a multi-figure narrative scene with a glyph-like text band across the top, whereas B is a thick three-dimensional block worked into a head-and-body form whose ornament is sparse, symmetrical and non-narrative.
